conflicts.summary: The manufacturer DE page for this exact product returns 404 and the exact-GTIN Rossmann page is 'not available' on 2026-10-10 although both served the same list on 2026-08-24. Only dm.de still lists the exact GTIN (Lieferbar). Possible delisting/rename/reformulation in progress; cannot be told apart from the evidence reachable today.

Codecheck's user-entered list omits Piroctone Olamine, Dimethiconol and Parfum and contains typos (xylenesulfate, gylcol, sosium, propylene gylcol). Treated as an incomplete transcription, not as a formula difference; support only.
Claim 'Mit Manuka-Honig und Ceramide-Komplex' (dm PDP): INCI contains 'Mel Extract' but no ceramide-type ingredient and no manuka-specific name.
conflicts.quote: Zudem enthält die Haarpflege Manuka-Honig und Ceramide-Komplex.

canonicalReason: dm.de, exact GTIN 8700216496032 / 250 ml, current 2026-10-10, publishes a complete 34-item list identical (item for item) to the 2026-08-24 manufacturer capture and the 2026-08-24 Rossmann exact-GTIN capture and the 2026-08-10 dm capture. No competing complete list exists. Claim-vs-INCI: 'Manuka-Honig' = Mel Extract (honey extract, not Leptospermum-specific in INCI) and 'Ceramide-Komplex' is NOT present as any ceramide INCI (no Ceramide NP/AP/EOP etc.) - recorded below.
normalization: Canonical list split on ',' at parenthesis depth 0 (so synonym groups such as 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' stay one item), trailing full stop removed; per item: lower-case, trim, collapse internal whitespace; asterisks, parentheses and slashes kept as published; items joined with '|'; sha256 over the UTF-8 string.
notes: Tier-3 basis is dm.de today plus identical exact-GTIN captures of Rossmann and the manufacturer page from 2026-08-24 (both now unreachable). Strictly on 2026-10-10 evidence alone this is a single live German retailer; treat as tier 3 only with that caveat.
NEEDS NICK: possible delisting at Rossmann and manufacturer site; catalog row should be checked for continued availability/GTIN (dm still sells it, 'Lieferbar').

Claim-INCI conflict: dm claims 'Mit Manuka-Honig und Ceramide-Komplex' and 'Feuchtigkeitsspendend', but the INCI has only 'Mel Extract' (honey) - no manuka-specific name and no ceramide ingredient. Also 'Regeneriert' claim has no INCI basis. Not a block.

The sibling DERMAXPRO products on headandshoulders.de are different GTINs ('Empfindliche Kopfhaut Shampoo' sku 8006530222037, 'Beruhigend' = G02 GTIN 8700216328661); the old 'Sensitive Pflege' slug is not in the 2026-10 sitemap.
